text: Smoke reported on the 30th floor at 1000 Louisiana St, Houston. Alarm panel shows floor 30.

out.briefing:
PRIMESIGHT | FIRE | FLOOR 30 | Wells Fargo Plaza, 1000 Louisiana St, Houston
ABOVE FIRE: ~2441 people on floors 31-71; NextDecade Corporation also on 31, 32, 33
ON FLOOR: NextDecade Corporation, suite unknown, ~144 people by headcount (daytime)
OCCUPANCY: NextDecade lists 575 employees, may cover floors 30-33; no hazmat or vulnerable flags
HYDRANTS: 61 m N, 62 m NE
INSIDE: no scan of floor 30; nearest is floor 36 (same core, layout may differ), 18 scan points
EXIT SIGNS: seen at 11 of 18 scan points, pull stations at 2 (floor 36 scan, not stair locations)
BUILDING: 71 stories, built 1983, steel frame, sprinklers yes
ROOF: membrane, 1 AC unit; OPEN LOT for staging ~491 m SW (aerial search, verify)
PROPERTY MGR: CBRE 5556193343 (text queued asking them to meet crew in lobby)
NOT KNOWN: stair locations, standpipe locations, sprinkler type
SCAN: https://my.matterport.com/show/?m=jUnF84zghQk

texts.text: Fire Dept: smoke reported on floor 30, Wells Fargo Plaza. Please meet fire crew in lobby with fire control room/alarm panel access, stair and standpipe info, and elevator keys.

tenant_flags.risk: High occupancy on the fire floor and the floors above
tenant_flags.why: The tenant data lists 575 employees in 13,576 sq ft on floor 30. NextDecade is also listed on floors 31, 32 and 33, so that headcount may cover all four floors. Either way, expect a large number of people to evacuate on the fire floor and on the floors directly above it, where smoke will rise. The tenant's industry and description are blank, so there is no support for a hazardous materials flag.
